Simulated Customer Spend Data

Source: R/data.R
spend_data.Rd

Simulated transaction-level data with covariates, generated from the gamma-gamma model fitted by GGcov_MLE. The data mimic the structure of retail transaction logs with covariates, such as the apparel example in the CLVTools vignette (Bachmann et al., 2025). spend_data holds 1000 customers; spend_data_sample is a random subset of 300 customers for quick examples.

Usage

spend_data

spend_data_sample

Format

A data frame with one row per transaction and 5 variables:

Id

Customer identifier.

Price

Amount spent in the transaction (strictly positive).

discount

Time-varying numeric covariate: the discount applied to the transaction, between 0 and 1.

gender

Time-invariant factor with 2 levels ("female", "male"), repeated on each of the customer's rows. The first level is the reference.

channel

Time-invariant factor with 3 levels ("store", "web", "app"), repeated on each of the customer's rows. The first level is the reference.

An object of class data.frame with 858 rows and 5 columns.

Source

Simulated; see data-raw/spend_data.R.

Details

Each row is one transaction. The true parameters used to generate the data are p = 2 (within-customer shape), q = 8 (mixture shape), gamma = 200 (mixture rate), and coefficients -0.8 (discount, per unit), -0.3 (gender male versus female), 0.3 (channel web versus store) and -0.4 (channel app versus store).

References

Bachmann, P., Kuebler, N., Meierer, M., Naef, J., Oblander, E., & Schilter, P. (2025). CLVTools: Tools for Customer Lifetime Value Estimation. R package version 0.12.1. https://github.com/bachmannpatrick/clvtools

Examples

head(spend_data)
#>   Id Price discount gender channel
#> 1  1 14.93     0.31   male   store
#> 2  1 21.12     0.01   male   store
#> 3  2 23.43     0.49 female     web
#> 4  2 50.20     0.43 female     web
#> 5  2 17.34     0.48 female     web
#> 6  3 25.85     0.06 female     web
